spatial_partitioning.name: Spatial Partitioning: Dividing Space
spatial_partitioning.truth: To understand space, divide it. Every partition reveals structure hidden in continuity.
spatial_partitioning.qfep_connection: Spatial partitioning algorithms find order in continuous space—the λ parameter tuned for organization. Voronoi finds natural territories, Delaunay optimal connections, BSP recursive divisions.
spatial_partitioning.description: Algorithms that divide space into meaningful regions. Voronoi diagrams partition by proximity, Delaunay triangulation connects optimally, BSP trees divide recursively, Poisson sampling distributes evenly.
learning_objectives: Voronoi diagrams: regions of closest proximity
Delaunay triangulation: dual of Voronoi, optimal connections
Binary Space Partitioning: recursive spatial division
Poisson disk sampling: even random distribution
Applications: terrain, cities, networks, game levels
